The '''''Insanity Claws''''' was a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]], that was owned by the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Haast Aath]].

==History==
During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Aath flew to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] in the ''Insanity Claws'', in command of a number of [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-controlled [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. He then captured a number of [[Tarasin]] to force into slavery and put them aboard the droid-controlled ships, then left the system with the ''Claws'' and the slaves. He then flew to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tharados]], where he had a slave compound.
